title: Opioid Fill Safety Edits — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Clauses.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit:

1. A first opioid fill for a member with no paid opioid claim in the network's opioid-naive lookback is limited to the network's initial opioid days supply; a longer fill rejects until the pharmacy reduces it or a coverage review approves it.
2. An opioid claim whose daily dose, added to the member's other active opioid claims, exceeds the network's daily morphine milligram equivalent limit rejects without a coverage review approval.
3. Members with an active cancer, sickle cell or hospice diagnosis on a coverage review approval are exempt from both edits.

## Edit outcomes

| Member has an active cancer, sickle cell or hospice diagnosis on a coverage review approval | First fill for an opioid-naive member is longer than the initial limit | Combined daily dose exceeds the limit | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Any | Neither edit applies |
| No | Yes | — | Rejects until the pharmacy reduces the fill or a coverage review approves it |
| No | — | Yes | Rejects without a coverage review approval |

## Reading the dose clause

The daily dose that is compared with the limit is the claim's own daily dose added to the daily doses of the member's other active opioid claims, not the claim's dose alone.
